approach E enters yellow at step 106
approach E still yellow at step 107 then red at 108, so yellow lasted 2s

explanation: Actuated EW green ends early then its yellow is truncated to 2s instead of required 4s: E/W green at step 105, yellow only at steps 106-107, all-red/NS red at step 108. Fixed-time with identical timings passes, so actuated transition logic cuts yellow short.
vision_note: The east-west signals are green in step 105, then turn yellow for steps 106 and 107. By step 108 all four approaches are red, so the yellow lasted only two seconds.
